title: YI 4K 1.10.7 EIS minimal native execution prerequisite matrix
scope: Offline evidence matrix only; no device RAM, firmware, partition, boot-area write, payload execution, or deployable command.

status_definitions.confirmed: Directly covered by bounded evidence for the fixed firmware identity and documented test model.
status_definitions.partial: Related static or host evidence exists, but runtime ownership, concurrency, publication, or recovery is incomplete.
status_definitions.missing: No sufficient evidence yet; must be closed before the next gate.
status_definitions.stop: Stop further write/execute work and return to read-only observation.

rows.name: Fixed firmware identity and address scope
evidence: Fixed 1.10.7 RTOS SHA-256 and model are recorded in the first-entry and native-execution documents.
rows.missing: Re-record firmware fingerprint, boot ID, and mapping baseline before any device run.
rows.stop: Fingerprint, hardware identity, or mapping differs from baseline.

rows.name: Externally reachable controlled first-entry path
evidence: loadbin direct execution was excluded; shell registration and task ABI were recovered.
rows.missing: A complete loader or handler from Linux/SD input to a checked entry is not recovered.
rows.stop: Relying on arbitrary address jumps, unreviewed handlers, loadbin, echo_cortex, or a fixed BOSS slot.

rows.name: Exclusive code/constant allocation contract
evidence: A2100000..A3100000 is a static NC/XN=0 candidate; allocator alignment, original/aligned ownership, and release were host-validated.
rows.missing: Runtime handle, free/contiguous capacity, contention, lifetime, and an external allocation control plane.
rows.stop: Original/aligned ownership or pool membership cannot be proven; borrowing zero, audio, USB, DSP, or free-list memory.

rows.name: Runtime page-table and execution-attribute readback
evidence: Static MMU construction contains Normal non-cacheable XN=0 AP=3 RAM.
rows.missing: Current TTBR/SCTLR, active page table, aliases, and runtime attributes.
rows.stop: Runtime XN=1, alias mismatch, or mapping may have been changed by recovery paths.

rows.name: Write integrity and data-cache publication
evidence: Allocator locks use DMB/DSB and existing D-cache helpers are identified.
rows.missing: New-code write/readback ordering, exact length, and completion acknowledgement.
rows.stop: Readback, length, checksum, or write completion is uncertain.

rows.name: Instruction-cache and branch-state synchronization
evidence: ICIALLUIS/ICIALLU occurrences are confined to BOSS resume/restore, MMU, or low-power contexts; no generic clear-cache API was found.
rows.missing: A target-buffer, target-core, returnable I-cache invalidate/ISB protocol with completion acknowledgement.
rows.stop: Slicing cache instructions from another function or substituting DSB/NC attributes for first-fetch proof.

rows.name: Execution core and SMP visibility
evidence: BOSS callbacks, inter-core notification, and task core exclusion order are statically recovered; notification has no remote completion receipt.
rows.missing: Fixed execution core, absence of stale pointers/fetches, and cross-core publication completion.
rows.stop: Target core or remote completion is unknown; another core may read an old pointer.

rows.name: Task or synchronous-handler ABI
evidence: Task wrapper, create/core-exclusion/resume order, and dispatcher ABI are recovered.
rows.missing: A32/Thumb state, stack alignment, register ABI, exception path, and unregister semantics.
rows.stop: Unknown ABI/stack/core mask or borrowing the main, EIS, or video stack.

rows.name: Independent minimal-probe result channel
evidence: Native logs, linux_util_svc, and a fixed result area are candidate channels; read-only diagnostics already work.
rows.missing: Exclusive result-area ownership and non-ambiguous enter/return/error/timeout receipt.
rows.stop: Inferring entry from missing logs or using a result area another task may overwrite.

rows.name: EIS isolation and bypass constraints
evidence: Stock EIS producer and VCAP/ORC publication audits identify the production boundary; host shadow/side-channel tests exist.
rows.missing: Proof that the minimal probe cannot touch EIS mutexes, rings, DSP publication words, DMA/MMIO, or recording state.
rows.stop: Probe changes EIS tables, shared feedback, DMA/MMIO, recording state, or stock return values.

rows.name: Exit, revocation, and release order
evidence: Documents require task stop, command return, and disappearance of old pointers before freeing original memory; ordinary registration lacks full unregister.
rows.missing: Runtime stop receipt, old-caller quiescence, pointer revocation, and safe free acknowledgement.
rows.stop: Task/handler may still run, an old core may retain a pointer, or consumers cannot be proven stopped.

rows.name: Cold-start and failure recovery
evidence: Boot ID, RTOS state, and pool construction are available from read-only evidence; static boot extension is offline only.
rows.missing: Independent recovery path, real cold-reset test, trigger disablement, and firmware/partition rollback validation.
rows.stop: Shell recovery is unavailable, device is lost, fingerprint changes, or rollback cannot be verified.

rows.name: Phased device validation strategy
evidence: A staged plan exists: fixed marker/log, idle, preview, then short recording; read-only and ordinary-recording recovery are evidenced.
rows.missing: Per-stage input, timeout, receipt, recovery, and evidence-file contract for a native entry.
rows.stop: Any stage exceeds its stop condition or requires an unreviewed expansion of write scope.

required_for: code execution that may crash, disconnect, brick, or require physical recovery
